places.name: Rishikesh
places.description: Yoga Capital of the World on the sacred banks of the Ganges, famed for iconic suspension bridges (Ram Jhula and Lakshman Jhula), spiritual ashrams, Ganga Aarti, and white-water river rafting.
places.best_time_to_visit: September to April
places.entry_fee: Free; paid activities for rafting and adventure sports
places.opening_hours: Open 24 hours; ashrams and temples daytime
visitor_notes: Attend evening Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan
Respect local ashram decorum and avoid non-vegetarian food

places.name: Haridwar
places.description: Ancient holy city where the Ganges enters the Indo-Gangetic Plains, revered for Har Ki Pauri ghat, monumental evening Ganga Aarti, and centuries-old Hindu pilgrimage traditions.
places.best_time_to_visit: October to April
places.opening_hours: Open 24 hours; Har Ki Pauri Ganga Aarti at dusk
visitor_notes: Reach Har Ki Pauri by 5:30 PM for a good view of the evening Aarti
Watch personal belongings in crowded ghats

places.name: Mussoorie
places.description: The 'Queen of the Hills' perched on the Garhwal Himalayan ridge, renowned for colonial charm along Mall Road, Kempty Falls, Gun Hill ropeway, and panoramic vistas of the Doon Valley and snow peaks.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November
places.entry_fee: Free; ropeway and specific viewpoints have nominal charges
places.opening_hours: Daytime; Mall Road lively in evening
visitor_notes: Heavy traffic during peak summer weekends
Enjoy the stroll along Camel's Back Road

places.name: Nainital
places.description: Celebrated Kumaon lake city nestled in a green valley around emerald Naini Lake, famous for Naina Devi Temple, vintage boat rides, Governor's House, and Snow View vantage point.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and October to February
places.entry_fee: Free; boating and cable car fees apply
places.opening_hours: Daytime; Mall Road pedestrianized in evenings
visitor_notes: Evening walk around Mallital and Tallital is scenic
Book parking or use shuttle during peak season

places.name: Naini Lake
places.description: Natural crescent-shaped freshwater lake that forms the vibrant pulsating core of Nainital, offering iconic paddle and rowing boat rides surrounded by seven verdant Himalayan peaks.
places.best_time_to_visit: Throughout the year (March to June best)
visitor_notes: Life jackets are mandatory on all boats
Beautiful reflections during early morning and sunset

places.name: Jim Corbett National Park
places.description: India's oldest national park and premier Project Tiger haven, encompassing dense sal forests, the Ramganga River, and rich populations of Royal Bengal tigers, wild elephants, and over 600 bird species.
places.best_time_to_visit: November to June (Dhikala zone opens Nov 15)
places.entry_fee: Safari permit and vehicle fees apply; advance booking mandatory via official portal
places.opening_hours: Morning safari 6:00 AM – 9:30 AM; Afternoon safari 2:00 PM – 5:30 PM
visitor_notes: Book safari permits months ahead on the official forest department portal
Carry valid ID matching permit details
places.map_search: Jim Corbett National Park Ramnagar Uttarakhand

places.name: Valley of Flowers National Park
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage alpine valley in the high Western Himalayas, blanketed in hundreds of rare wild alpine blooms, endemic medicinal flora, tumbling streams, and snowcapped cirques.
places.best_time_to_visit: July to September (peak bloom in August)
places.entry_fee: ₹150 for Indians, ₹600 for foreigners (valid for 3 days)
places.opening_hours: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM (entry closes by 2:00 PM; overnight stay prohibited)
visitor_notes: Requires a 14 km trek from Govindghat to Ghangaria, then 4 km to the valley
Carry rain gear, trekking poles, and pack out all trash
places.map_search: Valley of Flowers National Park Chamoli Uttarakhand

places.name: Hemkund Sahib
places.description: Sacred high-altitude Sikh gurdwara situated at 14,107 ft beside a pristine glacial lake ringed by seven snow-clad peaks, revered as the meditation place of Guru Gobind Singh.
places.best_time_to_visit: June to October (closed in winter)
places.opening_hours: 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM (all pilgrims must descend to Ghangaria by afternoon)
visitor_notes: Steep 6 km climb from Ghangaria; ponies and palanquins available
Brahma Kamal flowers can be seen along the trail

places.name: Kedarnath Temple
places.description: One of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas and the most revered temple of the Chota Char Dham, standing dramatically against the towering snow-covered Kedarnath massif at 11,755 ft above the Mandakini River.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to June and September to October (closed in winter)
places.entry_fee: Free; VIP darshan fees may apply
places.opening_hours: 4:00 AM – 9:00 PM (closed for bhog in afternoon)
visitor_notes: 16 km uphill trek from Gaurikund; helicopter services available with advance registration
Carry heavy woolens even in summer

places.name: Badrinath Temple
places.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu, one of the four all-India Char Dham and Chota Char Dham pilgrimage centers, situated between Nar and Narayana mountain ranges beside the Alaknanda River.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to June and September to November (closed in winter)
visitor_notes: Take a holy dip in Tapt Kund natural hot sulfur spring before darshan
Visit nearby Mana, the first Indian village on the border

places.name: Gangotri Temple
places.description: High-altitude shrine dedicated to Goddess Ganga at 10,200 ft along the rushing Bhagirathi River, marking the sacred origin point where the river touched earth and gateway to Gaumukh glacier.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to June and September to November (closed in winter)
visitor_notes: Permits required for trekking further to Gaumukh and Tapovan
Evenings can be very cold; dress in warm layers

places.name: Yamunotri Temple
places.description: Sacred seat of Goddess Yamuna perched against the Kalind mountain at 10,797 ft, featuring thermal springs like Surya Kund where pilgrims cook rice in cloth bags as prasad.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to June and September to November
visitor_notes: 6 km uphill trek from Janki Chatti base camp; pony and doli options available
Surya Kund hot water spring has immense religious significance

places.name: Auli
places.description: Premier Himalayan skiing resort and alpine meadow surrounded by coniferous oak forests, offering panoramic views of Nanda Devi (India's second highest peak) and a world-class cable car ropeway.
places.best_time_to_visit: December to March for snow skiing; April to June for meadows
places.entry_fee: Free; ropeway and skiing equipment rentals apply
visitor_notes: Joshimath to Auli ropeway is one of Asia's longest ropeways
Carry warm thermal clothing and sunglasses for snow glare

places.name: Chopta
places.description: Known as the 'Mini Switzerland of Uttarakhand', an idyllic high-altitude alpine meadow (bugyal) surrounded by dense evergreen rhododendron and deodar forests, serving as base for the Tungnath trek.
places.best_time_to_visit: April to November for lush green bugyals; December to February for snow
visitor_notes: Eco-sensitive zone; no permanent concrete hotels; eco-camps and homestays available
Limited electricity and mobile network connectivity

places.name: Tungnath Temple
places.description: The highest Shiva temple in the world at 12,073 ft, one of the sacred Panch Kedar shrines, connected further upward to the dramatic Chandrashila peak offering a 360-degree Himalayan panorama.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to November (closed during heavy winter snow)
visitor_notes: 3.5 km well-paved uphill trek from Chopta
Extend 1.5 km to Chandrashila summit for breath-taking Himalayan views

places.name: Ranikhet
places.description: Tranquil cantonment hill station founded in British times, famed for lush pine forests, apple orchards, the Kumaon Regimental Centre Museum, and high-altitude golf course with western Himalayan views.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November
visitor_notes: Visit Chaubatia apple orchards for fresh fruit and jams
Maintains an impeccably clean, serene cantonment environment

places.name: Almora
places.description: Cultural heart of the Kumaon region perched on a horse-saddle shaped ridge, renowned for unique local architecture, traditional craft bazaars, Bal Mithai sweets, and ancient Kasar Devi temple.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November
visitor_notes: Taste authentic Kumaoni Bal Mithai and Singori sweets in Lala Bazaar
Visit Kasar Devi, famous for its geomagnetic energy field

places.name: Pithoragarh
places.description: Known as 'Little Kashmir', a scenic valley town in eastern Kumaon flanking Nepal and Tibet borders, featuring historic Chand-era Pithoragarh Fort and views of the Panchachuli snow peaks.
places.best_time_to_visit: April to June and September to November
visitor_notes: Gateway to Kailash Mansarovar and Milam Glacier treks
Panoramic views of Soar Valley from Chandak hill

places.name: Landour
places.description: Charming British-era cantonment town just above Mussoorie, famous for quiet deodar forest trails, colonial cottages, Char Dukan cafes, Rokeby Manor, and historic literary associations.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November
visitor_notes: Walking the Landour Infinity Loop trail through deodar woods is highly recommended
Try ginger lemon tea and waffles at Char Dukan

places.name: Tehri Lake
places.description: A colossal emerald reservoir created by the iconic Tehri Dam on the Bhagirathi River, transformed into a premier water sports destination offering jet skiing, banana rides, speedboating, and floating houseboats.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November
places.entry_fee: Free; activity and boat charges apply
visitor_notes: Asia's highest dam is situated adjacent to the lake
Advance booking recommended for overnight floating huts and houseboats
